results.title: Yankees’ Aaron Judge Receives Frightening New Injury Update
results.description: Aaron Judge has been absent from the New York Yankees lineup since the final day of May, sidelined by a stress fracture in his right first rib. The injury has kept one of baseball’s most dominant hitters on the shelf for more than two months, fueling ongoing questions about when the three-time American League MVP might return to the field.
